## Why This Is Asked
Explores real-world cross-architecture provenance enforcement and per-tenant key management in CNF environments.

## Key Concepts
- Architecture-aware image provenance
- Per-tenant KMS signing keys
- SPDX SBOM with architecture metadata
- OPA Gatekeeper policy for imagePull enforcement
- Namespace-scoped validation tests

## Code Example
```yaml
apiVersion: constraints.gatekeeper.sh/v1beta1
kind: K8sArchConstraint
spec:
 match:
   kinds:
   - Pod
 parameters:
   allowedArchitectures: ['amd64', 'arm64']
```

```yaml
# test Deployment (arm64 image on amd64 node should be rejected)
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: test-arm64-deployment
  namespace: test-namespace
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: test-arm64
  template:

      labels:
        app: test-arm64
    spec:
      nodeSelector:
        kubernetes.io/arch: amd64
      containers:

        image: example.com/app:arm64-latest
        imagePullPolicy: Always
```

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to architect cross-cluster, tenant-isolated config rollouts with dynamic proxy configuration.

## Key Concepts
- Envoy xDS dynamic configuration and Aggregated Discovery Service (ADS)
- Kubernetes CRD-based policy model per tenant with isolation
- Canary traffic shaping with weight and time-based rollout window
- Multi-cluster consistency and safe rollback mechanisms
- Observability hooks for validation during rollout phases

## Code Example
```yaml
# (a) Tenant Routing Policy with Canary Weight and Rollout Window
apiVersion: cnf.example/v1
kind: TenantRoutePolicy
metadata:
  name: tenant-a-api-v2
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  tenant: tenant-a
  targetCluster: cluster-west
  route:
    path: /api/v2
    backendRefs:
      - name: gateway-service
        port: 8080
  canary:
    weight: 0  # Start at 0%
    rolloutDuration: 30m
    stepWeight: 10  # Increment by 10% each step
    stepInterval: 5m
  rollback:
    enabled: true
    failureThreshold: 5  # Rollback if 5 consecutive errors exceed threshold
    errorRateThreshold: 0.05  # 5% error rate triggers rollback
  healthCheck:
    endpoint: /healthz
    interval: 30s
    timeout: 10s
---
# (b) Sidecar Config to Watch Policy and Push Updates
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: envoy-gateway-sidecar
  namespace: gateway-system
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: xds-controller
          image: cnf/xds-controller:latest
          args:
            - --policy-namespace=tenant-a
            - --xds-address=$(POD_IP):18000
            - --sync-interval=10s
          env:
            - name: POD_IP
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: status.podIP
          volumeMounts:
            - name: policy-config
              mountPath: /etc/policy
              readOnly: true
        - name: envoy
          image: envoyproxy/envoy:latest
          args:
            - --config-path /etc/envoy/envoy.yaml
            - --service-cluster gateway
          volumeMounts:
            - name: envoy-config
              mountPath: /etc/envoy
      volumes:
        - name: policy-config
          configMap:
            name: tenant-policies
        - name: envoy-config
          emptyDir: {}
---
# (c) One-Namespace Test Manifest for Canary Rollout and Rollback
apiVersion: cnf.example/v1
kind: CanaryRolloutTest
metadata:
  name: tenant-a-canary-test
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  policyRef:
    name: tenant-a-api-v2
  testStages:
    - stage: baseline
      duration: 5m
      expectedWeight: 0
      checks:
        - type: metrics
          metric: requests_total{path="/api/v2"}
          condition: equals 0
    - stage: canary_10pct
      duration: 10m
      expectedWeight: 10
      checks:
        - type: http
          url: http://gateway.tenanta.svc/health
          expectSuccessRate: 0.95
        - type: metrics
          metric: envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_xx{cluster="backend-v2"}
          condition: exists
    - stage: canary_50pct
      duration: 10m
      expectedWeight: 50
      checks:
        - type: http
          url: http://gateway.tenanta.svc/api/v2/users
          expectSuccessRate: 0.99
    - stage: full_rollout
      duration: 5m
      expectedWeight: 100
      checks:
        - type: http
          url: http://gateway.tenanta.svc/api/v2/**
          expectSuccessRate: 0.999
  rollbackTest:
    enabled: true
    triggerFailureAt: canary_50pct
    expectedBehavior: weight_reverts_to_0_within_2m
```

## Why This Is Asked
This question assesses real-world upgrade discipline in cloud-native networking functions (CNF): zero-downtime deployments, per-tenant TLS key rotation, and reliable KMS-backed certificate flows—all in a multi-tenant Kubernetes environment.

## Key Concepts
- Canary rollouts with per-namespace traffic control using progressive traffic shifting
- CSR-based TLS rotation via an in-cluster KMS-backed Certificate Authority

- Readiness probes with TLS handshake validation during upgrades
- Traffic shadows for testing new versions without affecting production

## Code Example
```yaml
# Example 1: Deployment rolling update strategy
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: gateway
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  replicas: 3
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 0
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: gateway
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: gateway
        version: v1.y
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: gateway
        image: gateway:v1.y
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8443
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /ready
            port: 8443
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 5
        env:
        - name: KUBERNETES_SERVICE_HOST
          value: "kubernetes.default.svc"
        - name: VAULT_ADDR
          value: "http://vault-in-cluster:8200"
```

```yaml
# Example 2: TenantRotation CRD for per-tenant TLS rotation
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: Certificate
metadata:
  name: tenant-mtls-cert
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  secretName: tenant-a-mtls-secret
  duration: 24h
  renewBefore: 12h
  issuerRef:
    name: kms-tenant-issuer
    kind: ClusterIssuer
  dnsNames:
  - gateway.tenant-a.svc.cluster.local
  commonName: tenant-a
---
apiVersion: security.example.com/v1
kind: TenantRotation
metadata:
  name: tenant-a-rotation
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  tenantNamespace: tenant-a
  certificateRef:
    name: tenant-mtls-cert
  rotationStrategy: rolling
  preRotationValidation:
    enabled: true
    timeout: 30s
```

questions.explanation:
## Why This Question Matters
This question assesses your understanding of certificate rotation, CSR workflows, SPIFFE identities, and tenant isolation in Kubernetes-based CNF (Cloud-Native Function) gateway platforms. It validates your ability to design lifecycle management solutions that operate without downtime and your competence in developing testable configurations before production rollout.

## Key Concepts
- Per-tenant CSR issuance within Kubernetes
- Rotating CA with short-lived certificates for enhanced security
- SPIFFE identities and TLS handshakes in multi-tenant CNF gateways
- Tenant isolation using separate namespaces

## Solution Architecture

### 1. Minimal CA Manifest

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: tenant-ca
  namespace: cnf-gateway
type: kubernetes.io/tls
data:
  ca.crt: <base64-encoded-CA-certificate>
  ca.key: <base64-encoded-CA-private-key>
```

### 2. CSR Flow and Approval Policy

```yaml
apiVersion: certificates.k8s.io/v1
kind: CertificateSigningRequest
metadata:
  name: gateway-csr
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  groups:
  - system:authenticated
  request: <base64-encoded-CSR>
  signerName: kubernetes.io/kube-apiserver-client
  usages:
  - digital signature
  - key encipherment
  - client auth
---
apiVersion: certificates.k8s.io/v1
kind: CertificateSigningRequest
metadata:
  name: gateway-csr
spec:
  approval:
  - user: system:controller:certificates-approver
    approval: true
  conditions:
  - type: Approved
    reason: TenantIdentityValidated
    message: CSR identity matches tenant namespace
```

### 3. Per-Tenant CA Rotation Policy (30-Day Renewal)

```yaml
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: Issuer
metadata:
  name: tenant-ca-issuer
  namespace: cnf-gateway
spec:
  ca:
    secretName: tenant-ca
---
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: Certificate
metadata:
  name: gateway-cert
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  secretName: gateway-tls
  issuerRef:
    name: tenant-ca-issuer
    kind: Issuer
  commonName: gateway.tenant-a.cnf
  dnsNames:
  - gateway.tenant-a.cnf
  spiffeURIs:
  - spiffe://cnf/tenant-a/gateway
  duration: 720h # 30 days
  renewBefore: 168h # 7 days before expiry
  usages:
  - digital signature
  - key encipherment
  - client auth
  - server auth
```

### 4. Test Manifest with Sidecar Validation

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: tenant-a
  labels:
    tenant-id: tenant-a
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: gateway
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  ports:
  - port: 8443
    targetPort: 8443
  selector:
    app: gateway
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: gateway
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: gateway
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: gateway
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: gateway
        image: cnf-gateway:latest
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8443
        volumeMounts:
        - name: tls-certs
          mountPath: /etc/tls
          readOnly: true
        env:
        - name: SPIFFE_ID
          value: spiffe://cnf/tenant-a/gateway
      volumes:
      - name: tls-certs
        secret:
          secretName: gateway-tls
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: test-validator
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  restartPolicy: Never
  containers:
  - name: validator
    image: curl:latest
    command: ["sh", "-c"]
    args:
    - |
      # Validate TLS handshake
      openssl s_client -connect gateway:8443 \
        -CAfile /etc/tls/ca.crt \
        -cert /etc/tls/tls.crt \
        -key /etc/tls/tls.key \
        -verify_return_error
    volumeMounts:
    - name: tls-certs
      mountPath: /etc/tls
      readOnly: true
  volumes:
  - name: tls-certs
    secret:
      secretName: gateway-tls
```

### 5. SPIFFE Identity Validation

Each tenant receives a SPIFFE identity in the format `spiffe://cnf/{tenant}/gateway`. The CSR approval policy validates that the requested identity matches the tenant's namespace before issuance, ensuring strict tenant isolation.
